title: Refund & Cancellation Policy | Transparent & Hassle-Free
text:
Refund Policy
HIREPRO REFUND & CANCELLATION POLICY
At HirePro, we understand how much you value every payment, hence we are committed to
making your refund experience as clean and transparent as possible.
WHY DOES HIREPRO COLLECT ONLINE PAYMENTS:
HirePro is a Recruitment Automation SaaS platform
Some HirePro customers ask HirePro to collect registration fees as part of the process
In such cases, HirePro enables Online Payment as a step in the registration process
THERE ARE FOUR KEY ONLINE PAYMENT SCENARIOS:
Payment was not deducted from the source, for any technical/non-technical reason
Payment was deducted from the source, but was not captured by the payment gateway
Payment was deducted twice, but was captured once by the payment gateway
Payment was deducted from the source, and successfully captured by the payment gateway
REFUND PROCESS FOR EACH ONLINE PAYMENT SCENARIO:
Payment was not deducted from the source, for any technical/non-technical reason:
Refund is not needed in such cases
The user may initiate the payment again in such cases
Payment was deducted from the source, but not captured by the payment gateway:
The refund will be automatically issued by the payment gateway
The refund will be processed in 7-10 working days
The refund will be issued back to same source that was used to make the payment
HirePro reserves the right to examine and verify the payment and refund claim.
Payment was deducted twice, but was captured once by the payment gateway:
The refund for duplicate payment will be automatically issued by the payment gateway
Payment was deducted from the source, and captured by the payment gateway:
If the fee was declared as non-refundable at the time of registration, then refund will not be issued.
If the fee was declared as refundable at the time of registration, then please contact the HirePro customer for whom you registered and made the payment
The refund will be issued only if HirePro receives approval from the HirePro customer
Upon customer approval, the refund will be manually issued
Upon issue of refund, the refund will be processed in 7-10 working days.
If the refund is not received within 10 working days of issuance, or for any other assistance, please contact
ams.helpdesk@hirepro.in
with following details:
Name of the customer you registered for and made the payment
URL of the registration form used to make the payment
Email ID used in the registration
Phone Number you used in the registration
